theme: Kindle Hollow: warm painted timber, cream masonry, violet/teal fabric and roofs, aged brass, small restrained magic.

assets.blurb: A carved oak chair with a plum cushion, scroll arms and brass studs.

assets.title: Trestle Table

assets.title: Writing Desk
assets.blurb: A sloped writing desk with drawers, an ink pot, quill and folded letters.

assets.title: Mapmaker’s Table

assets.title: Kitchen Dresser
